solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Victuals including large sea bass for fruitless venture

indicators.note: the word for victuals holds the next pieces within it, so it is opened up to take them

parts.note: victuals are provisions, food
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
a serran is a fish of the sea bass family

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to catch sea bass for dinner and the outing proves a waste of time.
explanation.walkthrough: The fish name is rare outside crosswords; 'including' wraps the provisions word round the size letter and the fish together.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for a pointless trip or task, one undertaken with no hope of success.

clue.text: Partial mark of upright lady's fingers

indicators.note: in a down clue, upright means the letters are read going up, backwards
only part of the phrase is used, some of its letters lying within it

explanation.surface: A woman's fingers held up leave a faint mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Lady's fingers is the British name for the edible green pods of this vegetable.

clue.text: Strokes of a cat, not male or female

indicators.note: not drops the following word's letters from the strokes

parts.note: lashes are strokes of the cat-o'-nine-tails whip
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: Someone describes a cat's caresses as sexless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strokes of a cat' suggests petting, but the cat is the cat-o'-nine-tails whip.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl or young woman, a Scottish and northern English word.

clue.text: Smoothly place empty barrel in drug loading area

parts.note: E is short for ecstasy, the drug

indicators.note: in places the emptied barrel inside the dock word

parts.note: a quay is a wharf where ships are loaded

indicators.note: empty strips the word of its inside letters

explanation.surface: Instructions to stow an empty barrel at the dock with the narcotics cargo.
explanation.definitionFit: Equably means calmly and evenly, without disturbance or fluctuation.

clue.text: Daughter's off booze in sporty venue

indicators.note: the daughter's letter is off, removed from the booze word

parts.note: drink is booze, alcohol
D abbreviates daughter, as in genealogy; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: A daughter has quit drinking and frequents a sports arena instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A rink is an ice or roller skating arena, or a curling or bowls venue.

clue.text: Brush cut up, fed to horse — in this?

definitions.text: Brush cut up, fed to horse — in this?

indicators.note: the shortened word is fed to, put inside, the horse word

parts.note: a nag is a horse

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read the letters backwards
cut docks the end of the broom word

parts.note: a besom is a broom of twigs, a brush

explanation.surface: Chopped brushwood is given to a horse, presumably in its feed bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brush' looks like a verb but is a twig broom; 'cut' docks it and 'up' turns the stub round before 'fed to' puts it in the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeding bag hung over a horse's muzzle holds its fodder, so the cut brush is fed in this.

clue.text: After 29, went sober

indicators.note: after says the going word comes behind the other piece

parts.note: 29 across means grade or tier, for which level is a synonym
headed means went, as in headed home

explanation.surface: Someone sobered up after a certain point.
explanation.definitionFit: Level-headed means calm and sensible, not swayed by emotion, like sober judgement.

clue.text: Player possibly broken by depression about golf score in Palace event?

indicators.note: the golfer's name is broken, split apart, by the next letters

parts.note: Gary Player, the South African golfer, is a possible Player

indicators.note: the dent goes about, around, the score

parts.note: a dent is a depression
par is the standard golf score for a hole

explanation.surface: A golfer's game falls apart at a royal function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Player' is Gary Player, a famous South African golfer. Buckingham Palace hosts summer garden parties, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: An outdoor social gathering on a lawn, famously held at the royal residence in London.

clue.text: Guess answer in second grade

parts.note: to bet is to make a guess, a wager on an outcome

explanation.surface: A student guesses the answer and lands only a second-class mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The second Greek letter labels the second class in grading schemes, as in a B-grade or beta-minus mark.

clue.text: Blunt quality of British-American female figurehead advancing new ship

parts.note: US abbreviates American, as in United States

indicators.note: advancing pushes one letter of the royal word further forward, nearer its start

parts.note: a queen is a female head of state, a figurehead
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: A queen launching a new ship is seen as a figurehead, with Anglo-American roots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advancing' moves the N of QUEEN one place forward, giving QUENE. A figurehead is also the carved figure on a ship's bow, which helps the nautical surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Brusqueness is abruptness of manner, the quality of being blunt and curt in speech.

clue.text: Give a little black object

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an end is an object or aim, as in a means to an end

explanation.surface: Someone hands over a small black item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give' looks like handing over, but 'Give a little' means yield slightly.
explanation.definitionFit: To bend is to yield or compromise slightly, flexing rather than staying rigid.

clue.text: Get immersed, certainly eliminating interior pressure, in this thing?

definitions.text: Get immersed, certainly eliminating interior pressure, in this thing?

parts.note: to bath is to wash, to get immersed in water

indicators.note: eliminating the interior takes out the central letter of the word

parts.note: yes means certainly
P is the physics symbol for pressure
here means in this place

explanation.surface: A deep-sea vessel resists water pressure so its occupants can safely go deep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thing' is the subject of the whole clue: this diving craft removes the pressure from within as you submerge.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong spherical diving vessel lowered by cable for deep-sea observation.

clue.text: Work up to Russian power grabs

indicators.note: to work something is to knead and rearrange it, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Getting up to the Russians' power grabs.
explanation.definitionFit: Usurpations are seizures of power or position without right.

clue.text: Bellow perhaps in a way to cause violence?

indicators.note: one name is placed in the short road abbreviation, sitting between its letters

parts.note: ST, street, is a way or road
Saul Bellow was a Canadian-American novelist; perhaps marks his first name as an example

explanation.surface: A bellow uttered in a certain manner might provoke a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bellow' looks like a shout but is the writer Saul Bellow; 'perhaps' signals that his name stands in for a Saul.
explanation.definitionFit: An assault is a violent physical attack on someone, an act of violence.

clue.text: End of import sanction for wine from central Europe

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: to okay is to sanction or approve

explanation.surface: Import sanctions on a central European wine come to an end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sanction' looks like a penalty but means approval.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet dessert wine from the Tokaj region of Hungary.

clue.text: Many a crock is needing attention in that case

parts.note: to give ear is to pay attention
then means in that case, as in 'then we'll go'

explanation.surface: An old crock of a car is falling apart and needs looking after.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crock' suggests a decrepit old vehicle, but here it is a clay pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A crock is an earthenware pot or jar, so many are made of baked clay.

clue.text: Penetrate guts, but not all the way

indicators.note: not going all the way, the word stops short of its last letter

parts.note: entera, plural of enteron, are guts, alimentary canals

explanation.surface: Something pierces the bowels, but only partly.
explanation.definitionFit: To enter is to go into, to pierce or get inside something.

clue.text: Fry hearts for anyone denouncing veggies

indicators.note: the heart of each word is its central letter or pair, taken from each of the three words

explanation.surface: A fry-up fan rails against vegetarians and their food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearts' takes the centre of each word: YO from 'anyone', UN from 'denouncing', G from 'veggies'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fry are newly hatched fish, the offspring of a fish, so they are its little ones.

clue.text: Use ears when shady dealer gets nose cut off

indicators.note: the nose of a word is its front, so the opening letter is lopped away

parts.note: a shark is a swindler or crooked dealer

explanation.surface: A crook pays for his dealings by losing his nose.
explanation.definitionFit: To hark is to listen, an old literary verb for paying attention with one's hearing.

clue.text: What do sheep have to say about lake, one in Wales?

indicators.note: the sheep's cry goes about, around, the letter for lake

parts.words: What do sheep have to say
parts.note: baa is the noise a sheep makes
L is a map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about what Welsh sheep think of a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: BALA is the largest natural lake in Wales, so 'one' refers back to the lake in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Bala is a natural body of water in Gwynedd, north Wales, also called Llyn Tegid.

clue.text: Trainee's heel and toe vacantly twisting

parts.note: a heel is a cad, a dishonourable man

indicators.note: twisting turns the two remaining letters round to read backwards
emptied of its inside, the word keeps only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A dancer in training performs a heel-and-toe step while spinning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vacantly' empties toe to TE; 'twisting' turns it to ET.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadet is a young person in training for the armed forces or police.

clue.text: Split with no love in heart, a character flaw

indicators.note: with no shows the zero letter removed from the heart word

parts.note: a core is a heart, the centre
love is zero in tennis, O
a vice is a flaw in character

explanation.surface: A heartless person's character flaw: no love inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A crevice is a narrow crack or fissure, a split in rock.

clue.text: Lipid substance seen over cheese cloth

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the word is flipped to read upwards

parts.note: fat is a lipid
feta is a Greek cheese

explanation.surface: Grease spotted on a cheese cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Taffeta is a crisp, lustrous woven silk or synthetic fabric.

clue.text: Work without reward like a wet kiss?

definitions.meaning: unpaid forced labour, toil for no pay
slobbery, covered in drool or saliva

explanation.surface: Unpaid drudgery compared to an unwelcome sloppy kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Unpaid forced labour is bondage; as an adjective from slaver, to drool, it also means slobbering.

clue.text: Old dress split across train

indicators.note: the tear word stretches across, enclosing, the targeting word

parts.note: a rent is a split or tear in cloth
to train a gun is to aim it

explanation.surface: A vintage gown has torn along its long trailing train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' looks like part of a dress, but it means aim, as with a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an archaic, literary word for clothing or attire.

clue.text: Musical intro to happy tune

indicators.note: the intro to a word is its opening letter

parts.note: an air is a tune or melody

explanation.surface: A show's opening number is a cheerful melody.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1960s rock stage show famous for its hippie songs, such as Aquarius.

clue.text: Ring declined after female becomes bishop …

indicators.note: becomes signals one letter changing into another in the word

parts.note: fell means declined, dropped
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A churchwoman's career: she declined to be a bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: The female letter F in FELL is swapped for the bishop's B.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring is to sound a bell; the noun is a call on the telephone, a bell.

clue.text: … similarly, frustrate a simmering state

indicators.note: similarly points back to the clue before, so female F gives way to bishop B again

parts.note: to foil is to frustrate, thwart

explanation.surface: Thwarting someone has left them simmering.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to 25: 'similarly' repeats that swap of F for B.
explanation.definitionFit: On the boil means bubbling and simmering, a state of heating.

clue.text: Coarse food ingredients common to intellectual and physical strength

indicators.note: only the letters shared by the two words for strength are kept

parts.note: brain means intellectual strength

explanation.surface: A wholefood shared by thinkers and strongmen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ingredients common to' keeps the letters BRAIN shares with BRAWN, physical strength: drop I from one, W from the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Bran is coarse husk of cereal grain, a fibrous food.

clue.text: Jogger's sources of information about music expressing brooding resentment

indicators.note: about tells us to turn the word for the press and broadcasting round

parts.note: the media, press and TV, are sources of information
emo is a rock genre known for introspective, emotional lyrics
ire is anger or resentment

explanation.surface: A runner's playlist sources of mood-setting, angsty music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jogger' suggests a runner, but it is a memory jogger. 'expressing' is a link: EMO followed by IRE. 'about' turns MEDIA into AIDEM.
explanation.definitionFit: A reminder note or memorandum that prompts the memory, a written prompt.

clue.text: Disgusting basis of class system

definitions.meaning: social standing or status, on which a class hierarchy rests

explanation.surface: A sneer at a society built on class.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means foul-smelling; as a noun it means status or position in a hierarchy.

clue.text: Man on board hoarding number of long fish caught? Cruel punishment for him

indicators.note: the chess piece hoards, keeps inside it, the fish catch

parts.note: the king is a chess man, a piece on the board
an eel haul would be a catch of eels, long fish

explanation.surface: A sailor on board stashes away fish he has caught and is cruelly punished for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man on board' looks like a crewman but is a chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: An old naval punishment dragging a sailor under a ship's hull from one side to the other.
